notes: Evidence registry for mappings. Null publication date means undated or not established, not today's event. Verification used public page text or indexed primary-source excerpts; not archived full-text snapshots. Recheck historical relationships for the event's date.

sources.title: Blue Owl Technology Finance company information

sources.limits: Primary company page; current relationship, not ownership of the BDC.

sources.title: Blue Owl Credit platform

sources.limits: Primary strategy page.

sources.title: Blue Owl GP Strategic Capital

sources.title: Bayview company overview

sources.title: BasePoint corporate structure
sources.supported_claim: BasePoint Group Inc. identifies itself as holding company for BasePoint Capital LLC and BasePoint Advisors LLC.
sources.limits: Holding-company relationship expressly stated by company.

sources.title: BasePoint fund and lending announcements
sources.supported_claim: July 30, 2026 announcement identifies BasePoint Rated Structure Fund I L.P. as advised by BasePoint Advisors. Separate note-transaction announcement distinguishes BasePoint Capital and BP Lender subsidiaries.
sources.limits: Do not invent individual BP Lender legal entities or equate adviser with commercial service provider.

sources.title: Neuberger fund-name changes
sources.supported_claim: Lists fund-specific name changes effective December 18, 2025 or February 28, 2026; site uses Neuberger while legal group remains Neuberger Berman Group LLC.
sources.limits: Does NOT establish a universal August 4, 2026 rename or changes to every NB private fund.

sources.title: NB Private Debt V close
sources.supported_claim: NB Private Debt V is Neuberger's direct-lending fund investing in senior secured, first-lien and unitranche US sponsor-owned company loans.
sources.limits: Reported raised figure includes leverage; do not label that figure equity commitments.

sources.title: NB Strategic Capital Fund II close
sources.supported_claim: NB Strategic Capital Fund II focuses on GP-led secondaries and continuation vehicles.
sources.limits: A GP-led secondary fund is not a GP-stakes fund merely because its name includes Strategic Capital.

sources.title: Apollo retirement platform
sources.supported_claim: Apollo describes its integrated Athene platform and 2022 merger.
sources.limits: Insurance relevance still requires a capital, origination or investment transmission mechanism.

sources.title: Bain Capital Credit overview
sources.supported_claim: Bain Capital Credit covers liquid/structured credit and private credit; Special Situations originated within Credit but evolved more broadly.
sources.limits: Do not automatically assign every Special Situations event to private credit.

sources.title: Bain Capital Credit 2025 financing review
sources.supported_claim: Release identifies Bain Capital Credit LP as an affiliate of Bain Capital LP and separates certain Special Situations AUM.
sources.limits: Confirms relationship without equating all mandates.

sources.limits: Primary strategy page.
